# Copilot Instructions

When working in this workspace, prefer to keep moving instead of asking for clarification.

- If the request is reasonably inferable from local context, make the smallest plausible change and continue.
- Do not ask follow-up questions for minor ambiguities; state the assumption briefly and proceed.
- Only stop to ask when a missing detail blocks the work, the action would be destructive or irreversible, or multiple interpretations would change the result materially.
- After making a change, validate it with the cheapest focused check available.
- Keep responses concise and action-oriented.
